title: Static Deep-Gape Curved-Lure Anglerfish
description: One new complete stylised deep-sea anglerfish-like exterior: a massive blunt head with real broad thick-lipped mouth cavity leads into a short deep body and abruptly narrowing tail stock, a small fan-shaped caudal and short lateral fins. Four simple tapered teeth arise from the actual upper/lower mouth material. A complete slender curved forehead lure reaches forward and down to a small solid pale terminal bulb; two lateral eyes sit in the upper cheeks. Full body/cavity/fin/lure arrays are new, not old fish with a lamp attached or a shortened moray. One static animal prop, zero scenes. Bulb is opaque pale matte material, not actual light/bioluminescence. No exact species, internal anatomy, predation, bite, dangerousness, swimming, pressure, rig, animation or interaction claim.
